variantDecisions.a-skin-brows: REJECTED_VISUAL: brows too high and sparse. No independent collision acceptance claimed.
variantDecisions.b-ridge-skin-brows: RETAIN_RESEARCH_ONLY: clearer pigment anatomy, reference albedo preserved, improved brow placement/density, static collision gates passed.

visibleImprovement: UV-mapped lips, nasal pigment and regional facial colour replace uniform clay albedo.
Brow fibres occupy a narrower, lower anatomical region; 637 independent skin-bound hairs remain visible.

strictLocalAssessments.reason: Mapped anatomical colour is a visible improvement. Legacy diffuse still contains baked shadow/scalp pigment; the microrelief is synthetic, and grazing-light realism remains limited.
Placement and density improved, but the short straight fibres still look etched, pale and procedural. A natural multi-scale groom is not complete.

scoreScope: Subjective component-only estimates with uncertainty, not measured realism or a full-character score. Both remain below the 80-point component release gate.
remainingDefects: Head hair is not modelled; baked scalp stubble in the diffuse is not 3D hair.
Face anatomy/identity, caruncle and mouth structures remain unfinished.
Legacy diffuse contains baked lighting; it is not a measured, fully de-lit PBR albedo.
Brow stroke regularity and fine/pale appearance remain artificial.
No blink, facial expressions or continuous motion proof.
Procedural micro-bump and regional shader inputs need engine baking/export; no runtime LOD/performance gate passed.
distanceScope: Brow vertices to body triangles only; not exact all-triangle minimum clearance.
nextAction: Build actual scalp/hairline, primary hair masses, guide clumps and finer strands as separate layers, then collision-aware motion. Keep working toward full head anatomy and native-to-evaluated facial deformation/blink transfer. Do not spend another round on small static brow parameter sweeps. Skin de-lighting/scalp-pigment cleanup and baking remain required before runtime promotion.
